system.description:
Use this skill when the target uses an action with a [Movement] tag while you are [Hidden]. Invalidate the effect of the action used by the target. This effect can be invalidated by the target using 1 Fate point. If you are using a weapon with [Range: Close], the limit of this skill is not used.

A special skill that hinders the movement of the enemy after erasing its presence. You will look like an invisible wall to the enemy.
